claims.summary: The generation path tries direct CourseIR authoring before native skeleton authoring only when the planner says a whole-course CourseIR response can fit.
Direct CourseIR must pass lesson coverage acceptance for concepts, assessments, facts, worked examples, constraints, and misconception correctives before it can bypass fallback paths.
Accepted direct CourseIR is handed from generation to deliverables once and compiles through CurriculumV1 projection without native Pass B.
Downloaded package manifests can disclose courseIR.directAuthoring proof separately from nativeAssembly proof.
The roadmap documents why genome-linked content matters, why it is not sufficient alone, and why thin giant-call JSON must fall back loudly.
